question: Can frozen OneJev choose, before execution, the input on which two implementations have different contract-relevant behavior?
fixtures: Use all eight compiled PR 51 APIs and both input modes. The target is computed by comparing the two executed, projected traces. There is exactly one distinguishing mode per API. The independent units are eight APIs.
selector: One text-only A/B forward per presentation. Give both source bodies, the measured effect (ordered callback sequence or count of a named callback), and two mode options. Withhold execution outputs, requirements for either mode, correctness labels and fixture IDs from the prompt. Select the larger of the A/B logits, A on a tie. No adapter, fit, temperature tuning or retry.
presentation: Cross original/reversed body order with original/reversed option order (A=0,B=1 or A=1,B=0), 32 live choices. The first body order and A=0 layout is the prespecified downstream policy. Report physical input selected, letter preference, within-API consistency, and mean binary Brier score for P(mode=1).
primary: Pass if at least seven of eight APIs have the correct choice in all four presentations, with at least three of four in each family. Also report per-presentation accuracy. Always-mode and always-letter baselines are 4/8 per layout on this balanced set.
host: Select the lowest supplied integer mode whose base and head differ on the measured effect. Sequence compares ordered callbacks; count compares only occurrences of the target callback. Forward the selected head observation and independent required value even when they match. If no supplied mode distinguishes, review source alone.
downstream: For the 32 original PR 51 source/contract reviews run the ordinary JSON reviewer live twice with the structured host gate: provide both modes (mechanical policy), or provide only the prespecified selector choice. Compare answers and F32 probabilities with the matching published PR 51 witness/source response. For the unfiltered selector comparison reuse its matching prior witness/control responses. Report correct, missed violations, false alarms and complete mutation pairs. No promotion on these eight APIs.
